name: PDF-QR-Scanner universal-scanner fixture corpus
decoderNotes: Observed results use zxing-wasm reader defaults (tryHarder/tryRotate/tryInvert/tryDownscale on, returnErrors off). Raster loading mirrors the app pipeline: canvas -> ImageData; containers the canvas cannot load were converted with magick/ffmpeg before decoding.

entries.notes: Identical payload across 8 containers. qr-transparent.png decodes to 0 codes as raw RGBA; 1 code after alpha is flattened on white (#20 measured).

Stored pixels are the upright scene rotated by metadata only: orientation-6 stored = upright rotated 90° CCW; orientation-8 stored = upright rotated 90° CW. createImageBitmap applies EXIF by default (#20); the stb Blob path ignores EXIF (harmless for 2D).
12 MP photo, QR top-right (~518px). Fits the old 4096² iOS canvas cap.
48 MP photo, QR top-right. Over the 4096² iOS canvas cap; fits 8192². Feeds the pixel-budget / oversize policy (fog: "Pixel-budget values").

144 MP "decompression bomb": 12000² is accepted by Chromium and Firefox (#20 measured; 20000² is too) and zxing still finds the corner QR via tryDownscale in Node — but it busts every device pixel budget and the iOS canvas caps. The oversize-rejection policy test case (fog: "Pixel-budget values and oversize policy").

expected.note: all four decode with zxing defaults on 3.1.6: low-contrast (26% luminance delta) still reads, skewed relies on tryDownscale, occluded has ~18% of the symbol covered in a centre band clear of the finder patterns, baked-rot90 relies on tryRotate

entries.notes: Low-contrast (26% luminance delta), ~25° skewed with shear, centre sticker occlusion over an EC-H symbol, and a QR whose pixels are rotated 90° with no EXIF. Borderline cases that document how far the default reader options go.

expected.note: Read expectations recorded per file in "samples"; all generated by zxing-wasm 3.1.6 full writer and read-verified below.

samples.note: UPC-A is reported as EAN13 "0" + text (13 digits) under broad selectors (#23 §2).
ITF-14 is reported as format ITF, text unchanged.
Add-on is only returned with eanAddOnSymbol:"Read" (default "Ignore" returns the main symbol only) — the unverified case from #23 §10.
contentType GS1, symbologyIdentifier ]C1, HRI renders AI in parentheses.
KNOWN MISREAD under broad selectors: TelepenNumeric decodes as TelepenAlpha with garbage text; only narrow ["TelepenNumeric"] reads it right (#23 §2).
Non-UTF-8 binary QR (ECI 899 from the writer); text is HRI-escaped, bytes are exact.
MicroQRCode is inside the ["QRCode"] symbology root (#23 §3).
rMQRCode is inside the ["QRCode"] symbology root.

entries.notes: Eight symbols in one image: QR, DataMatrix, Code128, EAN-13, PDF417, Aztec, UPC-A (reads as EAN13), ITF-14 (reads as ITF).

Real-style customer card: QR (customer URL) + 4 corner DataMatrix marks (2 distinct payloads, each twice). Default ["QRCode"] must return only the QR; all formats additionally return 4 DataMatrix reads (#23 §5).
Same card plus a Code128 strip (customer number, HRI) — the "1D-strip card" from #23 §10.
Single-image HEIC (pillow-heif/x265, q85). Native decode: Safari 17+ only; otherwise lazy libheif-js fallback (#21). python: {"pages": 1, "size": [4032, 3024]}

expected.note: Pages 1+2 carry the same payload A (dedupe/ordering case), page 3 carries B. Each IFD is one scan page (#21: utif2). 1-bit CCITT G4 — the realistic scanned document.

entries.notes: Mixed folder tree, also zipped as tree-mixed.zip. card-1.png exists in two subfolders with different payloads (duplicate basename case); PDF inside the tree has two pages with distinct payloads.

example.pdf copied byte-identical from the repo (10°-tilted vector QR, payload https://github.com/tsueri/PDF-QR-Scanner) — the baseline for the existing page,qr-code CSV. two-page-qr.pdf has one distinct payload per page for CSV row checks.
Non-barcode false-positive guard set: gradient photo, dense text page, random RGB noise, flat white. #23 measured 0 valid false positives on 303 similar images with returnErrors off.
